content: Bounded automation curve generation from named shapes (ramp up/down, dip-and-recover, rise-fall, slow cycle, hold-then-move) parameterized by depth/rate/length is textbook DSP math — no external library warranted. Standard practice: emit point lists (time,value) with linear or smooth (cosine/ease) interpolation between control points; sine/triangle generators for LFO-style cycles; all values normalized [0,1] matching Bitwig Parameter.set(double) normalized range. Pure TS functions (~100 lines) are testable with fast-check property bounds (monotone time axis, bounded point count, clamped values), matching project conventions. D-05-14 fixed bounds (1 param, <=16 bars, <=64 points, single device) are enforced at schema level, not in curve math.
